name: Sparse Domain Decomposition
definition: A technique to handle large scenes or disjoint clusters by decomposing the domain into fixed-size subdomains, each with a dedicated neural network (expert) and a gate function, inspired by sparsely-gated Mixture-of-Experts.
summary: Sparse Domain Decomposition partitions volumetric scenes into subdomains with dedicated neural networks and fixed gate functions, enabling parallel training and avoiding the coordinate clustering issues of single-network approaches.
